display.name: Kafka Metrics
display.description: Broker, producer, consumer, JVM and partition metrics for the Kafka cluster.

display.name: JVM GC Count
display.description: Tracks the total number of garbage collection (GC) events that have occurred in the Java Virtual Machine (JVM).

display.name: jvm.gc.collections.elapsed
display.description: Measures the total time (usually in milliseconds) spent on garbage collection (GC) events in the Java Virtual Machine (JVM).

display.name: CPU Recent Utilization
display.description: This metric measures the recent CPU usage by the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), typically expressed as a percentage.

display.name: JVM memory heap
display.description: The metric represents the maximum amount of heap memory available to the Java Virtual Machine (JVM)

display.name: Broker Count
display.description: Total number of active brokers in the Kafka cluster.

display.name: Request Times
display.description: This metric is used to measure the average latency experienced by requests across the Kafka broker.

display.name: Producer and Fetch Request Purgatory
display.description: Measures the number of requests that Kafka brokers have received but cannot immediately fulfill

display.name: Broker Network Throughput
display.description: Helps gauge the data throughput from the Kafka broker to consumer clients, focusing on the network usage associated with serving messages to consumers.

display.name: Consumer Offset
display.description: Current offset of each consumer group for each topic partition

display.name: Consumer Group Members
display.description: Number of active users in each group

display.name: Consumer Lag by Group
display.description: Helps Kafka administrators assess whether consumer groups are keeping up with the incoming data stream or falling behind

display.name: Consumer Fetch Rate
display.description: Metric measures the rate at which fetch requests are made by a Kafka consumer to the broker, typically in requests per second.

display.name: Messages Consumed
display.description: Measures the rate at which a Kafka consumer is consuming records (messages) per second from Kafka brokers.

display.name: Partition Count per Topic
display.description: Number of partitions for each topic

display.name: Current Offset ( Partition )
display.description: Current offset of each partition, showing the latest position in each partition

display.name: Oldest Offset (Partition)
display.description: Oldest offset of each partition to identify log retention and offset range.

display.name: In-Sync Replicas (ISR)
display.description: Count of in-sync replicas for each partition to ensure data availability.

display.name: I/O Wait Time
display.description: This metric measures the total time that producers are in an I/O wait state, indicating potential bottlenecks in data transmission from producers to Kafka brokers.

display.name: Request and Response Rate
display.description: Indicates how many requests the producer is sending per second, reflecting the intensity of the producer's interaction with the Kafka cluster. Also, helps Kafka administrators gauge the responsiveness of brokers to producer requests.

display.name: Average Request Latency
display.description: Helps Kafka administrators and developers understand the average latency experienced by producer requests.

display.name: kafka.producer.byte_rate
display.description: Helps measure the data output rate from the producer, indicating the load a producer is placing on Kafka brokers.

display.name: Bytes Consumed
display.description: Helps Kafka administrators monitor the data consumption rate of a consumer group, showing how much data (in bytes) is being read from the Kafka cluster over time.

spec.text: The Kafka Broker metrics here inform you of data loss/delay through unclean leader elections and network throughputs, as well as request fails through request purgatories and timeouts metrics
Kafka Producers send messages to brokers for storage and distribution by topic. These metrics inform you of the volume and rate of data sent, and the success rate of message delivery.
Kafka Consumer metrics provide insights into lag between message production and consumption, success rates and latency of message delivery, and the volume of data consumed.

Kafka brokers are Java applications that expose JVM metrics to inform on the broker's system health. Garbage collection metrics like those below provide key insights into free memory, broker performance, and heap size. You need to enable new_gc_metrics for this section to populate.

Kafka partitions are the unit of parallelism in Kafka. These metrics inform you of the number of partitions per topic, the current offset of each partition, the oldest offset, and the number of in-sync replicas.
